hero.headline: Graceful Boutique Attire & Memorable Custom Bouquets
hero.subtitle: Discover premium women's clothing and bespoke handcrafted bouquets designed to elevate your special moments with our warm, personalized store experience.

features.qualityDesc: Breathable, comfortable fabrics and curated selections for daily wear or celebrations.
features.bouquetDesc: Custom designs crafted to adapt seamlessly to your budget and theme preferences.
features.fittingDesc: Comfortable fitting room available in-store to ensure the perfect fit and look.
features.paymentDesc: Hassle-free transactions supporting Cash, universal QRIS, and direct Bank Transfer.

bouquetEducation.title: About Custom Bouquet Price Flexibility
bouquetEducation.desc: Every bouquet is uniquely handcrafted to order. You are free to determine your preferred colors, flowers, cash amounts, and decorative accents.
bouquetEducation.quote: Price estimates depend on complexity, flower/paper materials, and the denomination/number of money folds.

store.title: Visit Our Store
store.subtitle: Feel free to visit us in person to explore our clothing curation, try them in the fitting room, or discuss your dream bouquet directly.
store.hoursNote: Open daily including weekends & public holidays
store.fittingDesc: Dedicated comfortable fitting room available to try on clothes before buying.
store.paymentDesc: Accepting Cash, QRIS (Gopay/OVO/ShopeePay), and Bank Transfer.
